उज्जयनी f. (-नी) Ujjayani or Oujein, a city so called in Malabar, formerly
the capital of VIKRAMADITYA. It is one of the seven sacred cities
of the Hindus, and the first meridian of their geographers: the
modern Oujein is about a mile south of the ancient city.
 E. उत्
much, जयनी victorious or place of victory; from the military cha-
racter of its people; also अवन्ती and उज्जयिनी.

उज्जयन्त m. (-न्तः) The name of a mountain, part of the chain in the
west of India, part of the Vindhyan range: see रैवत.
 E. उत priv. and
जयन्ति a banner, or जयन्त the son of INDRA.
उज्जयिनी f. (-नी) The city Oujein. E. See उज्जयनी.

उज्जासन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter.
 E. उत् before जस् to kill, and ल्युट् aff.
